headerDisplay: The Home app's accessories in Homeswift, through Homeswift Wingman on a Mac. Pair a Wingman on the plugin's page: it finds them on the network.

name.title: Name
name.description: This block's name, shown in the logs and in the web UI.

devices.title: Paired Wingmen
devices.description: Written by the plugin's page when it pairs a Wingman.

id.title: Wingman ID
id.description: The ID Wingman announces over Bonjour, which keys this entry.

name.title: Name
name.description: The Wingman's name on the plugin's page and in the logs.

host.title: Address
host.description: The Mac's address. Bonjour updates it when Wingman moves.

port.title: Port
port.description: Wingman's port, 8619 by default. Bonjour updates it with the address.

token.title: Token
token.description: Given at pairing and sent with every request.

fingerprint.title: Certificate SHA-256
fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of Wingman's certificate, pinned at pairing.

homes.title: Homes
homes.description: Only these homes, by name. Empty: every home.

exclude.title: Leave out these accessories
exclude.description: Accessories to leave out, by name or HomeKit id.

excludeBridges.title: Leave out the accessories of these bridges
excludeBridges.description: By the bridge's name in the Home app. Homeswift's own bridges are always left out.

refreshMinutes.title: Read the whole home every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often names, rooms and new accessories are read again; 10 minutes by default. Value changes arrive at once.

fr.Accessories to leave out, by name or Hom: Les accessoires à laisser de côté, par nom ou identifiant HomeKit.
fr.By the bridge's name in the Home app. Ho: Par le nom du pont dans l'app Maison. Les ponts de Homeswift sont toujours laissés de côté.
fr.Given at pairing and sent with every req: Donné au jumelage et envoyé avec chaque requête.
fr.How often names, rooms and new accessori: La fréquence à laquelle les noms, les pièces et les nouveaux accessoires sont relus ; 10 minutes par défaut. Les changements de valeur arrivent aussitôt.
fr.Leave out the accessories of these bridg: Laisser de côté les accessoires de ces ponts
fr.Name: Nom
fr.Only these homes, by name. Empty: every: Seulement ces maisons, par nom. Vide : toutes les maisons.
fr.Read the whole home every (minutes): Relire toute la maison toutes les (minutes)
fr.The fingerprint of Wingman's certificate: L'empreinte du certificat de Wingman, épinglée au jumelage.
fr.The ID Wingman announces over Bonjour, w: L'identifiant que Wingman annonce par Bonjour, qui identifie cette entrée.
fr.The Mac's address. Bonjour updates it wh: L'adresse du Mac. Bonjour la met à jour quand Wingman change d'adresse.
fr.The Wingman's name on the plugin's page: Le nom du Wingman sur la page du plugin et dans les journaux.
fr.This block's name, shown in the logs and: Le nom de ce bloc, affiché dans les journaux et l'interface web.
fr.Wingman's port, 8619 by default. Bonjour: Le port de Wingman, 8619 par défaut. Bonjour le met à jour avec l'adresse.
fr.Written by the plugin's page when it pai: Écrit par la page du plugin quand elle jumelle un Wingman.

es.Accessories to leave out, by name or Hom: Los accesorios que se dejan fuera, por nombre o id de HomeKit.
es.By the bridge's name in the Home app. Ho: Por el nombre del puente en la app Casa. Los puentes de Homeswift siempre se dejan fuera.
es.Given at pairing and sent with every req: Se obtiene al emparejar y se envía con cada solicitud.
es.How often names, rooms and new accessori: Cada cuánto se vuelven a leer los nombres, las habitaciones y los accesorios nuevos; 10 minutos de forma predeterminada. Los cambios de valor llegan al instante.
es.Leave out the accessories of these bridg: Dejar fuera los accesorios de estos puentes
es.Name: Nombre
es.Only these homes, by name. Empty: every: Solo estas casas, por nombre. Vacío: todas las casas.
es.The fingerprint of Wingman's certificate: La huella del certificado de Wingman, fijada al emparejar.
es.The ID Wingman announces over Bonjour, w: El id que Wingman anuncia por Bonjour, que identifica esta entrada.
es.The Mac's address. Bonjour updates it wh: La dirección del Mac. Bonjour la actualiza cuando Wingman cambia de dirección.
es.The Wingman's name on the plugin's page: El nombre del Wingman en la página del plugin y en los registros.
es.This block's name, shown in the logs and: El nombre de este bloque, que se muestra en los registros y en la interfaz web.
es.Wingman's port, 8619 by default. Bonjour: El puerto de Wingman, 8619 de forma predeterminada. Bonjour lo actualiza con la dirección.
es.Written by the plugin's page when it pai: Lo escribe la página del plugin al emparejar un Wingman.

pt.Accessories to leave out, by name or Hom: Os acessórios a deixar de fora, por nome ou id do HomeKit.
pt.By the bridge's name in the Home app. Ho: Pelo nome da ponte na app Casa. As pontes do próprio Homeswift ficam sempre de fora.
pt.Given at pairing and sent with every req: Obtido no emparelhamento e enviado com cada pedido.
pt.How often names, rooms and new accessori: A frequência com que os nomes, as divisões e os acessórios novos são lidos de novo; 10 minutos por predefinição. As alterações de valores chegam de imediato.
pt.Leave out the accessories of these bridg: Deixar de fora os acessórios destas pontes
pt.Name: Nome
pt.Only these homes, by name. Empty: every: Apenas estas casas, por nome. Vazio: todas as casas.
pt.Read the whole home every (minutes): Ler a casa inteira a cada (minutos)
pt.The fingerprint of Wingman's certificate: A impressão digital do certificado do Wingman, fixada no emparelhamento.
pt.The ID Wingman announces over Bonjour, w: O id que o Wingman anuncia por Bonjour, que identifica esta entrada.
pt.The Mac's address. Bonjour updates it wh: O endereço do Mac. O Bonjour atualiza-o quando o Wingman muda de endereço.
pt.The Wingman's name on the plugin's page: O nome do Wingman na página do plugin e nos registos.
pt.This block's name, shown in the logs and: O nome deste bloco, mostrado nos registos e na interface web.
pt.Wingman's port, 8619 by default. Bonjour: A porta do Wingman, 8619 por predefinição. O Bonjour atualiza-a com o endereço.
pt.Written by the plugin's page when it pai: Escrito pela página do plugin quando emparelha um Wingman.
